wedding.label: Wedding
wedding.heroAlt: Outdoor wedding reception setup — Forever Party Rentals
wedding.tagline: Curated wedding rental packages for {size}-guest celebrations across the Lower Mainland — priced, bundled, and 10% less than booking items separately.
wedding.intro: Whether you're hosting an intimate ceremony or a full-tent reception, our wedding packages bundle the essentials — tables, chairs, and optional tent — at 10% off the a-la-carte total. Every package is designed around {size} guests with the 10% chair-spare rule built in, the right tent size pre-selected, and Tier 3 adding the garden-wedding aesthetic with ambient bistro lighting and cocktail-hour tables with spandex covers.

faqs.q: Can I customize what's in a wedding package?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The package is a starting point — add linens, dance floor, heaters, or upgrade chairs before checkout. Anything you add keeps the 10% package discount on the original bundle; add-ons are at standard rates.

faqs.q: What if my guest count changes after I book?
faqs.a: We'll adjust to the next package tier if it fits — no repricing surprises. If you're between sizes (e.g., 75 guests), we recommend the 100-guest package so you have the right tent footprint and enough chair spares.

faqs.q: Does the wedding package include delivery and setup?
faqs.a: Delivery and professional setup are available as an add-on across all tiers — included in every quote we send. Pickup from our warehouse is also available with the same 10% package discount applied.

corporate.label: Corporate
corporate.heroAlt: Corporate gala dinner setup — Forever Party Rentals
corporate.tagline: Corporate event packages for {size}-guest galas, product launches, and company dinners — 10% off when you bundle tables, chairs, and tent together.
corporate.intro: Built for corporate planners: 6ft banquet tables for seated dinners, cocktail highboys for networking, and the right tent for outdoor company events. Tiers 1 & 2 include one cocktail table per 15 guests for cocktail-hour networking; Tier 3 upgrades to our Garden Premium with spandex-covered cocktail tables and bistro string lighting for a more refined gala aesthetic.

faqs.q: Do you invoice businesses directly for corporate events?
faqs.a: Yes. We accept company credit cards, cheques, and email invoicing with net-15 terms for established corporate clients. Email welcome@foreverpartyrentals.com for an invoice-ready quote.

faqs.q: Can we add AV, stage, or sound equipment?
faqs.a: We don't carry AV ourselves, but we partner with trusted Lower Mainland AV vendors and can coordinate delivery windows so everything arrives and sets up together.

faqs.q: What about charity or non-profit events?
faqs.a: We offer discounted rates for registered non-profits in addition to the 10% package discount. See our Corporate & Charity page for details.

backyard.label: Backyard
backyard.heroAlt: Backyard party rental setup — Forever Party Rentals
backyard.tagline: Backyard party packages for {size}-guest birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, and family celebrations — all the essentials, 10% off.
backyard.intro: Family-style banquet seating, reliable outdoor chairs, and a pop-up-free setup — our backyard packages are built for the Lower Mainland climate and designed to look great even on grass, gravel, or stamped-concrete patios. Tier 3 is the celebration upgrade: Resin Garden chairs, a tent, bistro string lights for the evening, and cocktail tables with spandex for your cake or welcome display.

faqs.q: Can you set up on grass or on my back patio?
faqs.a: Yes — our crew carries both engineered stakes for grass and ballasted weight kits for pavement, driveways, and stamped-concrete patios. Let us know your surface type when booking and we'll confirm the anchor method in your quote.

faqs.q: What if I just need chairs and tables without the tent?
faqs.a: That's Tier 1 (Essentials). You still get the 10% package discount versus booking each item separately, and you can always add a tent or other items later without losing the bundle price.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum order or delivery fee for my neighborhood?
faqs.a: Package pricing covers the rental items; delivery is calculated based on your postal code. Pickup from our warehouse is always available with the 10% discount applied and no delivery charge.

tiers.marketingSubline: Tables and chairs — perfect for indoor venues or covered patios.

tiers.name: Covered
tiers.marketingSubline: Everything in Essentials, plus a professionally-installed marquee tent sized for your guest count.

tiers.name: Garden Premium
tiers.marketingSubline: Resin Garden chairs, marquee tent, ambient bistro string lighting, and cocktail tables with spandex covers for your cake, gift, or welcome display.
